summary: Targeted re-verification of the 3 fixes in commit 98aa6bf on preview. ALL THREE PASS. (1) Corporate hero CTA now syncs form kind: 'Request a Corporate Proposal' scrolls the form into view, selects the proposal tile and flips the submit label to 'Request a Corporate Proposal →'; a UI submission persisted with kind='corporate_proposal' plus company/guests/occasion; clicking 'Book a Corporate Tasting' after the proposal CTA flips back and persisted kind='corporate_tasting'. (2) /contact renders the Instagram row from settings.general.instagram_handle (href https://instagram.com/notasalami, text @notasalami); clearing the handle in admin Settings hides it on BOTH /contact and the footer; restoring '@notasalami' brings both back. Handle restored and verified via GET /api/settings. (3) Inquiries CSV export now contains kind, company, preferred_date, location, num_guests, occasion, special_requirements with correct values for a corporate inquiry. All ZQTEST8 records deleted; DB verified clean.

minor.issue: num_guests is typed as str in the Pydantic model — sending a JSON number (22) returns 422. Public UI sends a string so no user impact, but API consumers/integrations may trip on it. Consider Union[int,str] or coercion.

issues: 'subject' is still exported raw (e.g. 'Corporate proposal') rather than the friendly 'Request' label shown in the table; acceptable since 'kind' is now exported alongside it
'Preferred date' still uses the browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a styled/shadcn calendar — pre-existing, cosmetic

action_items: None blocking — all 3 items from commit 98aa6bf verified on preview; safe to redeploy to notasalami.com.

Optional (carried over from iteration_7): add at least one notification recipient in Settings so corporate inquiry emails actually send; consider extracting a shared instagramUrl() helper (logic is still duplicated in Footer.jsx and Contact.jsx); Admin.jsx remains ~1600 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx now duplicates the Footer's instagram-handle normalisation (settings?.general?.instagram_handle || CONTACT.instagram, strip leading @). Correct but duplicated — extract to a hook/util so the two surfaces cannot diverge again.
exportCsv special-cases active === 'inquiries' with a hard-coded field list; a per-tab exportExtraKeys config on the columns definition would be cleaner and avoid the same omission for future tabs.
CorporateInquiryForm's useEffect prop sync is correct and guards against redundant state writes; no stale-prop path left.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 3 inquiries: zqtest8_prop@example.com (UI, proposal), zqtest8_tast@example.com (UI, tasting), zqtest8_export@example.com (API, CSV fixture). DB verified free of ZQTEST8 records. Instagram handle toggled empty -> restored to '@notasalami'.
